verdict.rationale: Airweave is open-source and self-hostable (git clone, ./start.sh) and exposes a documented OpenAPI/CLI surface, giving some data portability and avoiding lock-in, but there is no explicit documented bulk-export feature or open-format export tooling for a user's synced data. missing for 10: explicit data export/backup feature, documented open export formats, evidence of a 'leave and take your data' workflow.
